feeds.title: WBOY 12News
feeds.description: 12WBOY is the No. 1 news resource for West Virginia viewers. Their mission is to report about their state and surrounding communities fairly, accurately, and completely with the best informed and most professional news staff. They provide local news & weather for north-central West Virginia. They also provide statewide and national news stories.

feeds.title: Dominion Post
feeds.description: At The Dominion Post, we publish products that our readers and advertisers find informative, useful, accurate, reliable and enjoyable. We are committed to progress, tradition, integrity, growth, excellence, and maintaining our place as the dominant news media in Monongalia and Preston counties. It is your source for local Morgantown area news, sports and entertainment coverage in the surrounding area.

feeds.title: Morgan Messenger
feeds.description: The Morgan Messenger delivers up-to-the-minute news and information on the latest top stories, sports, obituaries, local news and more.The award-winning Morgan Messenger has been the weekly newspaper for Berkeley Springs, WV and surrounding Morgan County

feeds.title: WV.gov
feeds.description: WV.gov is the official Web site for the State of West Virginia and is the result of an innovative public-private partnership between the state and West Virginia Interactive. Get the latest breaking news and updates at WV.gov.

feeds.title: WFXR » West Virginia
feeds.description: WFXR is the FOX affiliate in the Roanoke-Lynchburg market. WFXR News delivers your local News, 'Pinpoint Weather' and Sports daily. It provids news, weather, sports and lifestyle coverage for West Virginia.

feeds.title: WOWK 13 News » West Virginia
feeds.description: WOWK 13 News is a Nexstar station in Huntington and Charleston, West Virginia. Broadcasting on channel 13, it is the CBS affiliate for the Charleston-Huntington market. We tell local Charleston-Huntington news & weather stories, and we do what we do to make Charleston-Huntington & the rest of West Virginia, Ohio, and Kentucky a better place to live.

feeds.title: West Virginia Explorer Magazine
feeds.description: Explore wild, wonderful West Virginia, adored with all of its Arts & Culture, Communities, and Attractions. West Virginia Explorer is an informational guide to West Virginia and has been in publication since 1999. Long classified as a travel guide, it has since evolved into a compendium of resources for West Virginia, including data on cultural and natural landmarks.

feeds.title: WOAY-TV
feeds.description: WOAY.com produces live news updates and digital coverage of all major news stories in Southern West Virginia. WOAY.com is the web channel of ABC 4, also known as WOAY-TV, a TV Station locally owned by the Thomas family since its inception, and is the ABC affiliate for the Beckley-Bluefield-Oak Hill television market.

feeds.title: WTRF
feeds.description: Learn about the latest news stories trending in your and surrounding counties as well as across West Virginia and the Country. WTRF.com and WTRF-TV is the local CBS and ABC affiliate. We tell local Wheeling news & weather stories, and we do what we do to make Wheeling & the rest of West Virginia a better place to live.

feeds.title: WVNS 59News
feeds.description: Explore local News, Weather, Sports, and Crime stories from WVNS-TV on this site. WVNS-TV or 59News is the CBS and FOX-affiliated Nexstar Media Group station for southern West Virginia. Their goal is to provide fair and balanced coverage of local news that benefits their viewers.

feeds.title: West Virginia Record
feeds.description: Discover thorough, analytical, article pieces covering the State and Federal courts. West Virginia Record is a legal journal covering West Virginia's legal system. Its goal is to provide an objective view of the legal landscape in West Virginia as well as an active forum for both sides of the argument.

feeds.title: WVVA
feeds.description: WVVA is your #1 resource for news in the Two Virginias. We cover a large part of southern West Virginia and SW Virginia including Beckley, Bluefield, Lewisburg, Oak Hill, PIneville, Tazewell and Welch.

feeds.title: WV MetroNews
feeds.description: Delivering the most accurate and up-to-date news headlines, sports news, and outdoor news across the city of Charleston, West Virginia. MetroNews is a statewide medium serving as a news, talk, and sports network providing you the ability to reach nearly all of West Virginia through a single source.
